theorems.name: Submission.codim1_zsl_pc_translation_estimate
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (F : Set (Euclid m)) (R c : ℝ), MeasurableSet F → (∀ φ : Euclid m → Euclid m, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid m) (R + 2) → (∀ v, ‖φ v‖ ≤ 1) → ∫ v in F, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid m) (fderiv ℝ φ v).toLinearMap ≤ c) → ∀ h : Euclid m, ‖h‖ ≤ 1 → volume (symmDiff ((fun v => v + h) ⁻¹' F) F ∩ ball (0 : Euclid m) R) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (c * ‖h‖)
